title: knowledge(events): ChangeCompany leaves triggers and trigger-event subscribers running in the calling company
summary: A knowledge article documents that ChangeCompany does not move trigger execution context to the target company; triggers and trigger-event subscribers still run in the calling company. StartSession is recommended for cross-company operations that require proper trigger handling.
key_points: ChangeCompany redirects only data access, not trigger execution context
Triggers, field validation, and database trigger-event subscribers run in the calling company regardless of ChangeCompany
Setting RunTrigger to false skips trigger code but not trigger events that subscribers receive
StartSession with company parameter is the recommended approach for cross-company writes requiring proper trigger execution
Best practice is to keep direct cross-company writes only for trigger-free hand-off tables
